# uem Provider

Terraform provider for Omnissa Workspace ONE UEM



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `auth_method` (String) Authentication method: 'basic' or 'oauth2'. Defaults to 'basic'. Can also be set via UEM_AUTH_METHOD environment variable.
- `client_id` (String) Client ID for OAuth2 Authentication. Can also be set via UEM_CLIENT_ID environment variable.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client Secret for OAuth2 Authentication. Can also be set via UEM_CLIENT_SECRET environment variable.
- `instance_url` (String) Workspace ONE UEM instance URL (e.g., https://your-instance.awmdm.com). Can also be set via UEM_INSTANCE_URL environment variable.
- `oauth2_token_url` (String) OAuth2 token URL. Defaults to https://na.uemauth.workspaceone.com/connect/token. Can also be set via UEM_OAUTH2_TOKEN_URL environment variable.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for Basic Authentication. Can also be set via UEM_PASSWORD environment variable.
- `tenant_code` (String, Sensitive) Workspace ONE UEM tenant code (API Key). Can also be set via UEM_TENANT_CODE environment variable.
- `username` (String) Username for Basic Authentication. Can also be set via UEM_USERNAME environment variable.
